summary: Zimmer Biomet Holdings filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement, dated November 5, 2026, for an offering of senior unsecured notes of an unspecified aggregate principal amount and coupon, maturing in 20__. Interest is payable semi-annually beginning 2027, with optional redemption and a change-of-control repurchase right at 101% of principal. A parallel euro-denominated notes offering was announced the same day, each conditional only on itself. Joint book-running managers are Barclays, BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho and SMBC Nikko. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
